 # Architecture
+
+## Wet paint simulation — internal dependency, authoring workflow unfinished
+
+`core/wet-paint.ts` defines strict internal load/mix settings; `engine/wet-paint.ts` validates bounded working tiles and invokes actual AssemblyScript/WASM kernels through the ordinary pixel worker. This is not yet an authored operation, public DOM constructor, tool, script/plugin service or REST endpoint. Document32/project3/workspace2 and portable preset v4 remain unchanged. Mixer/smudge completion still requires native spatial reservoir transport/replay, ordered layer replacement including transparency, shared commands/history/source references, UI gestures/previews, persistence and native/SVG/GPU capability handling.
+
+Reservoirs store Float32 encoded-sRGB premultiplied normalized RGBA, preserving sub-byte pigment between dabs. Initialization interpolates captured source pigment and an RGBA8 loaded color by `load` (0…1, default0); hidden RGB in transparent inputs contributes no pigment. Source and loaded alpha participate in that interpolation. Load is finite initial pigment, not an automatic refill on every dab. The default loaded color is opaque black.
+
+For each native destination pixel, `t = flow * coverage/255`. Deposit interpolates original premultiplied RGBA toward carried pigment by `t*(1-wetness)`. Pickup separately interpolates carried pigment toward the **pre-deposit** destination by `t*pickup`, avoiding feedback from partially processed output tiles. Flow defaults1, wetness0 and pickup0.5; each is finite0…1. Zero flow/coverage preserves both inputs exactly. Wetness1 preserves destination bytes while allowing pickup. Results have RGBA8 destination pixels and Float32 carried pigment; RGB is zero when an active deposit rounds output alpha to zero. Whole-stroke opacity and captured selection must mix the completed original/result once afterward, never scale each dab's pickup. This is encoded-channel paint mixing, not linear-light, spectral pigment or physical fluid simulation.
+
+Working requests admit at most4,000,000 complete pixels; larger native regions must be tiled without resizing their source. Carrier extent must match destination RGBA components; finite normalized alpha and premultiplied RGB are checked on both sides of the worker. Inputs/settings are captured before worker readiness and exclusively private buffers transfer. Outputs own their bytes across memory growth and subsequent requests. The working budget is not an image/stroke-size cap or a whole-process memory bound. No latency/device/60fps acceptance is implied by numerical correctness.

 # Canoli Studio System Design & Architecture Specification
+
+Wet paint currently has an internal numerical dependency, not a shipped mixer/smudge workflow. Captured pre-dab destination and spatial carried pigment are distinct immutable inputs. The worker executes actual WASM premultiplied RGBA transport and returns owned RGBA8 pixels plus Float32 reservoir state. Pickup samples pre-deposit pixels; each dab tile therefore has no dependency on the processing order of other tiles from that same dab. Zero flow/coverage is inert; alpha can increase or decrease. Initial load is finite; whole-stroke selection/opacity belongs to a later original/result composite. Caller data never transfers, and returned extents/normalized premultiplied channels are validated. Bounded working tiles must not become source/document limits. See ARCHITECTURE.md for the exact internal equations and defaults.
 
 Pen overlay reconciliation retains every native control while memoizing long paths in contiguous 64-anchor blocks. A changed block refreshes its markers; unchanged blocks retain existing SVG nodes. Short paths render directly, and fragments preserve original SVG ancestry and paint order. Each block retains only its own at-most-64 point references, avoiding retention of complete prior path arrays across independent block updates. Basis, zoom, selection, geometry length/coordinates and the large-translation precision fallback remain invalidation inputs. This is a UI rendering optimization; public constructors, validation, history, persistence and isolated extension boundaries remain unchanged.

import base64,difflib,hashlib,json,subprocess,tempfile
from pathlib import Path
prefix='/tmp/canoli-brush-wet-core-';p=lambda suffix:Path(prefix+suffix)
base=Path('/tmp/canoli-brush-mixer-baseline')
sha=lambda path:hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
subprocess.run(['python3',str(p('controller.py')),'verify'],check=True)
old=json.loads((base/'source-manifest.json').read_text());frozen=json.loads(p('frozen.json').read_text());changes={};before={}
for name,digest in old.items():
 if frozen[name]==digest:continue
 snapshot=base/name;assert sha(snapshot)==digest,name;before[name]=digest
 changes[name]=''.join(difflib.unified_diff(snapshot.read_text().splitlines(True),Path(name).read_text().splitlines(True),fromfile='before/'+name,tofile='after/'+name))
added={name:base64.b64encode(Path(name).read_bytes()).decode() for name in frozen if name not in old}
assert len(changes)==7 and len(added)==5,(len(changes),list(added))
unit=p('unit.log').read_text();assert '1303 passed' in unit and '162 passed' in unit
build=p('build.log').read_text();assert 'built in' in build
reports={}
for kind,count in [('browser',465),('production',78)]:
 captured=json.loads(p(kind+'-captured.json').read_text());stats=captured['report']['stats'];assert stats['expected']==count and stats['unexpected']==stats['flaky']==stats['skipped']==0
 assert len(captured['caseKeys'])==len(set(tuple(x) for x in captured['caseKeys']))==count
 assert json.loads(p(kind+'-exit.json').read_text())['exitCode']==0
 reports[kind]=captured
assert len(set(x[0] for x in reports['browser']['caseKeys']))==41
assert len([x for x in reports['browser']['caseKeys'] if Path(x[0]).name=='wet-paint.e2e.ts'])==5
proof={}
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='canoli-wet-paint-proof-') as temporary:
 root=Path(temporary)
 for name,digest in before.items():
  target=root/name;target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);target.write_bytes((base/name).read_bytes())
 patch=root/'changes.patch';patch.write_text(''.join(changes.values()));subprocess.run(['patch','-s','-p1','-i',str(patch)],cwd=root,check=True)
 for name,encoded in added.items():
  target=root/name;target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);target.write_bytes(base64.b64decode(encoded))
 for name in set(changes)|set(added):
  proof[name]={'expected':frozen[name],'reconstructed':sha(root/name)};assert proof[name]['expected']==proof[name]['reconstructed'],name
p('reconstruction-proof.json').write_text(json.dumps(proof,indent=2)+'\n')
